title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct final answer of approximately 2.2 x 10^-7 s.

title: Lorentz Transformation
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly applies the Lorentz transformation to relate the time intervals in different frames.

title: Velocity Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student accurately calculates the velocity of the jet plane in terms of beta.

title: Time Difference Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student derives the expression for the time difference between the two clocks correctly.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Numerical Substitution
description: Optional Criteria: The student correctly substitutes numerical values into the derived equations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to account for the small value of beta leading to incorrect approximations.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes a sign mistake in calculating the time difference.
